title: Automating Requirements Formalization: Using LLMs and Low-Complexity Distinguishing Traces for Semantic Validation
summary: The original ARTEMIS pipeline translates natural-language requirements into FRETish structured NL using an LLM, then maps them to LTL formulas, with semantic validation performed via low-complexity distinguishing traces using the Spot model checker.

This reproduction replaces the multi-step structured-NL translation pipeline with a direct LTL formula generation prompt over FRETish benchmark requirements, evaluated with pass@10 via Spot automaton equivalence.

dataset.name: FRETish benchmarks (deepstl-test, FSM-AP, FSM-S, REG, RobotExplain, Ventilator)
